status: SETUP_REQUIRED for external delivery and automated reminders; in-app/source current states remain visible

required_setup.company: event family enabled state; event purpose; responsible queue; authorised recipients; approved template and brand scope
required_setup.timing: timezone; optional reminder slots and repeat bounds; escalation milestones and stop conditions; applicable quiet hours/digest
required_setup.provider: actual supported channel/sender/domain; verification/test evidence; callback/auth handling and maximum retry schedule; unknown-delivery recovery
required_setup.personal: supported channel preferences, current device consent/subscription, safe contact destination and separate outreach preference
required_setup.privacy: minimum external payload, guarded links, sensitive audience/field projections and safe diagnostics
required_setup.release: unsupported channels unavailable; first-time invite/recovery verified end-to-end before real onboarding

safe_defaults.baseline_channel: in-app for authenticated scoped users; source action state persists
safe_defaults.push: unavailable until implemented/verified and user grants device permission
safe_defaults.private_external_content: generic short notice and protected link

publication: Draft preview and expected-version publish; previous working version retained on failure; policy changes reschedule only applicable future work and preserve history
